top_categories.workout_context: 81ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
6,562ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
At Muju Gran Fondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Muju Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Muju Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.

Road-specific control matters at Muju Gran Fondo. Practice on mountain passes: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 80 miles.
At mile 60 of 80, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
6,562ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Muju Gran Fondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mountain passes can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 80 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 80 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Muju Gran Fondo’s 80 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Muju Gran Fondo. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Muju Gran Fondo rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mountain passes to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, VO2max, and Over Under to prepare you for 80 miles of mountain passes in Muju County, North Jeolla Province, South Korea.
